update.releaseNotes:
v1.2.5 - Stability and speed
- Recreation dates are re-checked every turn (a bad icon read no longer disables them for the rest of a career). - Miracle Cure / Rich Hand Cream now stockpile up to 5 as intended. - Trophy-goal G1 selection reads the correct race's grade and fan count. - No more 10-second per-turn stalls on a flaky stat-table read; worst-case stall ceiling halved. - Mood recovery bails cleanly instead of looping on a missing screenshot. - Switching character presets no longer wipes your custom support/scenario event picks. - Faster hot path: lazy screenshots in the decision loop and trimmed waits.
